changelog:
Initial release of the Venice AI integration skill.

- Provides full access to the Venice AI platform: private text generation, multimodal web search, embeddings, TTS, speech-to-text, image generation, video creation, upscaling, and AI editing.
- Supports 30+ models (including uncensored and private), with OpenAI-compatible API for easy migration.
- Includes comprehensive script tools for model discovery, chat, web search, images, video, embeddings, TTS, and more.
- Designed for privacy, with zero data retention on private models and no content guardrails.
- Extensive setup and usage documentation included for seamless onboarding.
